record.title: Maungdaw–Teknaf river-cargo halt and first wood-shipment return, April 2025–May 2026
record.region: East and Southeast Asia and Oceania
record.start_precision: Day; explicit 12 April halt/last-arrival date, unknown clock
record.end_precision: Day of first scoped cargo return
record.scope: Maungdaw-to-Teknaf Naf River border-cargo corridor; coastal Yangon/Sittwe shipping excluded
record.crossings: Maungdaw river departure area / Teknaf land-port jetty; coordinate not approved
record.direction: Myanmar to Bangladesh; the endpoint does not establish reverse exports
record.movement: Maungdaw-origin river cargo; first observed return is one wood consignment
record.exceptions: No claim of all commodities, passengers, maritime cargo, regular sailing or full normal trade.
record.imposing_authority: AA approval/tax obstruction and later-described junta suspension; exact sequence unresolved
record.enforcement: Port officials and an on-site July report describe the halt. A Maungdaw-origin wood boat is reported actually arriving on 1 May 2026.
record.consequences: No general economic effect is quantified by this research packet.
record.relationship: No Maungdaw–Teknaf parent is present in the full Register/phase index. January 2025 Yangon–Teknaf coastal cargo is a different route and is not backdated into this land-frontier river phase.
record.status_observation: Historical dated evidence only; an unknown endpoint is not evidence of present open or closed status.
record.current_corrections: The 384-day value is a difference between calendar dates to a first scoped cargo return, not measured hours or proof that the whole onset day was closed. The 14 April 2026 announcement is not the endpoint. Reverse exports, all commodities and regular service remain unestablished. Yangon/Sittwe coastal shipping is excluded; the actor and stated-reason sequence remains attributed and unresolved.
record.rationale_coding_status: Source-attributed coding accepted after separate challenge; qualifications retained
record.rationale_phase_note: Codes apply only to their stated phase and attribution; no common primary rationale or complete temporal overlap is presumed.
